MERGED: Gerrit 1226 (9da306dc60) + 1227 (d72c4777d3), submitted as a stack; both landed at
LLM-Review +1 (PASS, 2 advisory / 0 blocking on 1226) AND Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments.
Content confirmed on gerrit/main after submit (Gerrit rebases on submit).

Local verification alongside: `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler` 1828 passed;
`tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing` 252 passed; `tests/unit/test_external_isolation.py` 2
passed; `REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 pytest tests/external/live_jira_dc --collect-only` still collects
49 live cells, so `_live_jira_ready` is intact in `test_dc_mutations.py` and the module is still
visible to the all-skip canary (the hole change 1203 had to repair).

STILL OPEN ON THIS STORY: one harness run confirming BOTH [04-transition-status] (d067's fix
merged as 8961f12664 / 2ea5c3391d) and the inbound-assignee cell are green. The assignee cell
cannot be exercised on this host — the harness image is linux/amd64 and stalls under arm64
emulation (`tests/external/live_jira_dc/README.md:53-67`) — so its live verdict comes from CI.
